References

This library was developed based on the following paper:

  • Topological Mesh Operators
    Luiz Velho, Hélio Lopes, Esdras Medeiros, Thomas Lewiner, Geovan Tavares,  submitted (PDF)
In the code example, the mesh construction is based in the Advancing Front Triangulations approach and one can found it in:

  • A Topological Framework for Advancing Front Triangulations
    Esdras Medeiros and Luiz Velho and Hélio Lopes, In Proceedings of SIBGRAPI. IEEE Press, 2003. (PDF)
Also, In the same example, the sqrt(3) subdivision scheme can be found in:

  • sqrt(3) Subdivision
    Leif Kobbelt, In Proceedings of SIGGRAPH 2000, Computer Graphics Proceedings - Annual Conference Series, 103-112, 2000.
